entries.message: This update adds explicit library monitoring, redesigned Manual Watch Review, tracker hold and Simkl skip review, expanded compressed remote backups, and local storage compression with an upgrading progress screen and storage optimization controls, alongside faster parallel sync and reliability fixes.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Feature: Sync Activity includes a Watch updates on hold panel grouping held Trakt and Simkl writes by movie or show with episode and provider details, Check watch status to recheck eligible holds and report cleared vs remaining counts, and Cancel selected updates to remove selected holds while keeping local and tracker watch history.

Feature: Add explicit library monitoring controls across Plex, Emby, and Jellyfin, enforcing selection across resume, Next Up, personal rating scans and writes, Jellyfin resume checks, unwatched fallback polls, live session completion, scoped Force Sync, and manual retry routes.

Feature: Redesign Manual Watch Review with inline date-option buttons showing which neighbouring episode each suggestion was based on, collapsed season groups, flush show posters, top-right Dismiss and bottom-right Confirm watched without a second confirmation popup, and single background bulk confirmations and dismissals that survive leaving or refreshing the page.

Feature: Shows with episodes skipped for Simkl because of alternate numbering now offer Review Simkl updates in Sync Activity, matching each skipped watch by title and air date and sending only exact aired-number matches through normal batch, backup, quota, and readback checks.

Feature: Expand remote backup destinations with Dropbox sign-in, S3-compatible storage, WebDAV, and external folders alongside Backblaze B2 in Settings and guided setup, with independent watch-history and full-backup schedules, retention overrides, streaming uploads, upload status, on-demand backups, provider-specific help guides, and grouped remote restore results.

Feature: Compress encrypted full backups (about 19x smaller on typical libraries) with clear damaged-file detection before restore; older backups still restore, while new compressed full backups cannot be restored by older Plekt releases.

Feature: Compress large JSON payloads in local SQLite databases and shared metadata caches and remove legacy duplicate metadata tables from the main database, cutting typical storage use dramatically without losing data (keep a pre-upgrade backup if you might roll back).
Feature: Display a theme-aware Upgrading Plekt screen with live progress during one-time upgrade database compaction, then open Plekt automatically when finished.

Feature: Add a Storage Optimization panel under Settings -> General -> Storage & Cache with card-based disk usage gauges, specific active task labels, smooth auto-scroll on expand, and controls to compact databases, optimize cached artwork, and recompress legacy uncompressed backups with live per-file progress.
Feature: Add a configurable Watch Audit Retention setting under Settings -> Sync -> Sync Tuning (default 90 days, or 0 to retain diagnostic audit events forever; watch history is never deleted).

Fix: Importing every file from a Trakt export no longer adds a random, unrelated movie for each show; per-show watched summary files are now skipped instead of being read as movies carrying the show's TMDB number.
Fix: Trakt collection files are no longer imported as watches, so movies you own but have not watched stay unwatched.
Fix: Opening per-show Up Next options no longer throws an error on show pages.

Fix: Resolve Force Sync episode matching, watch dates, Plex historical watched sync enforcement, Trakt durable retry loops, queued-retry outcome preservation, Simkl batch quota lock release, Plex movie fallback matching, episode personal rating series IDs, Plex WebSocket subpath preservation, and cross-process cache version bumps.

Fix: Isolate multi-tenant in-memory state, watch-history backup folders, tenant artwork restores, and active user browser caches; block secret reuse on server URL changes, add DNS metadata-IP pinning, encrypt backup passphrases and remote destination secrets at rest, strip calendar feed tokens from portable exports, and sanitize frontend URLs and CSS backdrops.

Fix: Resolve dropped-only show detail visibility, sign-out and sign-in live update SSE lifecycle with backoff, stuck action buttons, stale detail render races, listener and poller leaks, and Up Next controls including per-show options, Now Playing reorder bindings, and Mirror order and hide safety.
Tweak: Simkl rechecks due held watches in batches of up to 100 and clears a hold only when Simkl reports the same item at the same watch time.
Tweak: Retry failed shows the watch action, the affected apps and their recorded errors before retrying, then keeps the popup open with the result and any new app errors.
Tweak: Retry failed now covers Simkl: a Simkl update that was never sent because the watch arrived without IDs is queued again with the resolved IDs.
Tweak: A refused retry shows the server's reason instead of a generic failure, and Retry is only offered for apps that can be retried.
Tweak: Show the zero-library warning banner on cold loads to Dashboard and every non-Settings route, sitting in its own row above the desktop Dashboard with fixed mobile height at narrow widths.

Tweak: Scope personal rating baselines and Force Sync plan staleness to the library selection revision so deselecting a library never triggers synthetic clears, strip portable backup library selections on restore, and harden plugin library context validation.
Tweak: Changing which libraries are selected takes effect immediately for library membership checks.

Tweak: A Plex library selected while Plekt is running is checked for manual watched marks on the next poll instead of up to an hour later, and a manual watched mark made in Plex just before a settings save is no longer skipped when the background check restarts.
Tweak: Preserve provider item provenance on Manual Watch Review approvals and Plex notification lookups so queued Simkl writes pass library checks and settle reliably.
Tweak: Update Sync Activity rows cleanly when queued Simkl writes settle, cancel, or require review, preventing stale pending states and misleading empty-target summaries.
Tweak: Improve Up Next provider feed sync, Mirror mode ordering and safe hide passes, per-show override controls, Dashboard recovery, and settings dialog focus and session guards.

Tweak: Plex, Emby and Jellyfin catch-up imports, library availability checks and resume to Next Up chains run in parallel, so a three-server catch-up finishes several times faster without duplicate watches.
Tweak: Recent-watch imports recheck the item inside one database transaction, so two servers reporting the same watch at once record it only once.
Tweak: Up Next builds, show progress updates, settings loads and the pending sync sweep do far less repeated work, so the dashboard and background ticks stay quicker on large libraries.
Tweak: Sync Activity keeps every row, retry and dismissal, but trims recognized raw request and response bodies after 90 days to stop the database growing.
Tweak: Sync Activity stops its periodic refresh while the browser tab is hidden and refreshes when you return.
Tweak: Season details on show pages lay out with fewer reflows, keeping wrapped episode heights exact.
Tweak: Document that Emby 4.9.5.0 and 4.10.1.0 both accept rating writes without storing them and that Plekt reads back to report the failure.
Tweak: Sync Activity results explain Simkl alternate-order skips in plain words, and the Episode order dialog explains that Simkl receives watches it can match in both catalogues.

Tweak: Find matching Jellyfin and Emby episode copies when Up Next has seen only one copy, repair missed episode watches during scheduled catch-up after verifying series identity, and retry Emby and Jellyfin watch and progress updates with a fresh lookup when a saved item ID no longer exists.
Tweak: Keep watch source and sync results visible in Media Info and include the newest 2,000 matching audit events in the export.
Tweak: Simplify the Clear progress confirmation copy with an inline media preview and match confirmation dialogs to the site's dark and light modal theme.
Tweak: Migrate existing local full backups to the Plekt-named folder at startup.

Tweak: Publish a public privacy policy explaining how self-hosted data, connected services, backups, install metrics, and public analytics are handled (including a public privacy policy URL for Dropbox).

Tweak: Optimize existing cached artwork to sharper, smaller WebP files once in the background after upgrading, gzip-compress rotated access and diagnostic logs, and prune unused non-Windows binaries and build sources from Windows packages.

Tweak: Add two-way dropped-title sync notes for Trakt (shows) and Simkl (shows and movies), include YouTube and optional AniDB in the Metadata sources overview, and add provider support matrix docs and faster poster cache and TVDB SQLite indexes.

messageFragments: Fix - Stop Trakt JSON imports adding unrelated movies from show summaries
Feature - Add tracker write review, explicit library monitoring, faster background sync and clearer sync retries
Feature - Review skipped Simkl episodes, redesign manual watch review and sync watches across library copies
Feature - Expand remote backup destinations and restore controls
Feature - Compress encrypted full backups and publish the privacy policy
Feature - Compress local storage, add upgrading screen, and add storage tools
Fix - Make legacy backup recompression start on approval with live progress
Fix - Style Storage Optimization buttons and scroll panel into view on expand
